title: A DEFINE MEASURE with the name of a model measure replaces it for the query
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Sales Amount] = SUM ( Sales[Quantity] )

source.quote: Measure definitions for a query override model measures of the same name for the duration of the query.
source.supports: the query definition is the one used

source.quote: When the measure already exists in the model, the DAX query will use the measure DAX formula defined in the query.
source.supports: the query definition is the one used

derivation: The model measure is SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) = 540. The query redefines it as SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ) = 1 + 2 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 15, an integer, and that is what the reference returns.
